summary: Not ready: two blockers hold the score down, the 80 town pages that only swap the town name and a noindex on the home page. The boiler and heat-pump pages are solid & well linked, and this run fixed the staging canonicals and the sitemap host. Fix the two blockers first, then the slow combi-boiler page, the short HSTS header and the long titles; the owner's call on AI crawlers is under Decisions. Everything else is minor.

findings.title: 80 town pages differ only by the town name
findings.what: Intros and FAQs are one template with `{town}` swapped, so “Zürich” & “Winterthur” read the same; the crawler found 1,204 page pairs sharing over 60% of their main text. Related: CONTENT-04.
findings.why: Google treats pages that only swap a place name as doorway pages and can filter them or hold down the whole site.
findings.fix: Publish only towns with real local proof (jobs, photos, reviews from that town), each with its own intro and FAQs, in `src/data/towns.ts`. Hold the rest with the publish flag.

findings.title: The home page is noindex
findings.what: The home page sends `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` from a leftover staging header in `next.config.ts`.
findings.why: Google drops a noindex page from search, and the home page carries the brand searches.

evidence.detail: headers() adds X-Robots-Tag for every path

findings.fix: Remove the X-Robots-Tag header from `next.config.ts` for production builds.

findings.title: HSTS max-age is one day
findings.what: `Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=86400` on every page; the preload list asks for a year and **includeSubDomains**.
findings.why: A short HSTS lifetime leaves visitors open to downgrade attacks between visits.
findings.fix: Set `max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains` in the CDN's response headers.

findings.title: The combi-boiler page fails Core Web Vitals (LCP 4.6 s)
findings.what: The hero image is a 2.4 MB JPEG loaded lazily; real visitors wait 4.6 s for it. Related: PERF-08.
findings.why: Slow pages lose visitors and rank lower in close calls.
findings.fix: Serve the hero as WebP at 1,600 px, give it `fetchpriority="high"` and drop `loading="lazy"` in `src/components/Hero.tsx`.

findings.title: 52 canonicals pointed at the staging host
findings.what: Canonicals used `https://staging.example.com` because `NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL` was unset in the production build.
findings.why: Canonicals on the wrong host send ranking signals to a site that shouldn't be indexed.
findings.fix: Set the production origin in one place and use it for `metadataBase`.

fixed.summary: metadataBase now reads SITE_URL, which fails the build if missing; production env updated.
fixed.verified: re-crawl 20 Nov: 0 canonicals on the wrong host

findings.title: The sitemap listed localhost URLs
findings.why: Google ignores sitemap URLs on the wrong host, so new pages are found slowly.
findings.fix: Build sitemap URLs from the production origin.

fixed.summary: sitemap.ts uses the same SITE_URL constant as the metadata helper.
fixed.verified: re-crawl 20 Nov: all 1,240 URLs on https://www.example.com

findings.title: robots.txt blocks OAI-SearchBot and PerplexityBot
findings.what: The robots file blocks every AI crawler, including the search crawlers that decide whether the site is cited in AI answers.
findings.why: Blocking search crawlers keeps a local business out of AI answers; blocking only training crawlers is a common middle ground.
findings.fix: Decide the policy and record it in the SEO profile.

decision.question: Should AI search crawlers be allowed?
options: Block training crawlers only (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, CCBot)
decision.recommendation: Block training only, so the business can still be cited in AI answers.

findings.title: 14 titles are longer than 60 characters
findings.what: Service titles append “Fast & Friendly” and the brand, e.g. 74 characters for the boiler-repair page.
findings.why: Long titles get cut off in results, often losing the brand or the key phrase.

evidence.detail: 74 chars: Boiler Repair Zürich - Fast & Friendly <24/7> | Example Plumbing & Heating

findings.fix: Shorten the service title pattern in `src/lib/seo.ts` to “{Service} in {Town} | Example Plumbing”.

findings.title: The heat-pump guide lost its H1
findings.what: A layout change turned the H1 into a styled `<div>`.
findings.why: The H1 tells people and search engines what the page is about.

findings.title: Product schema has no aggregateRating
findings.what: The 40 shop products give no `aggregateRating`, so no review stars can show.
findings.why: Review stars can lift clicks on product results.
findings.fix: Add aggregateRating from the review system once it collects real reviews.

findings.title: 3 pages are linked from nowhere
findings.what: Old landing pages, such as O'Brien's partner page, have no internal links.
findings.why: Pages nothing links to are found late and rank poorly.

evidence.detail: another site's page, left out of page scores

findings.fix: Link them from `/about/` or retire them with a 301.

findings.title: The booking form's date field has no label
findings.what: The date input has a placeholder but no `<label>`.
findings.why: Screen-reader users can't tell what to type.

findings.title: Gallery images use “image1.jpg”-style names and empty alt text
findings.what: 18 gallery photos have `alt=""` and file names like `IMG_0042.jpg`.
findings.why: Image search can't tell what the photos show.
findings.fix: Write short alt text in the CMS gallery fields.

findings.title: No /.well-known/security.txt
findings.why: A missing security contact slows down people who want to report a problem.
